verdict_reason: The paging update is correct and the reworded title matches its new assertion, but the role-filter absence check on the unsearched first page can no longer fail now that the picker pages.

todos.issue: Line 72 checks 'Consignor Only <token>' is absent from the unsearched picker, but with paging only page 1 of 8 out of a growing shared address book is shown, so the row is absent whether or not role filtering works: removing the role filter does not turn this line red. Lines 71 and 85 assert PAGED_LIST_COUNT (/^Showing \d+ out of \d+ results$/), which matches any count and so only proves a summary line is shown. Role filtering is actually proven at line 76 ('Showing 2 out of 2 results' for a token the consignor-only address also carries).
todos.fix: Must: every assertion in this test can fail when the behaviour it stands for breaks; the role-filter check runs on a list the consignor-only address would appear in if it were not filtered. One way: move the absence check after searchFor(token) (line 74-78), where the list holds every token match on one page, and drop the line-72 check on the unsearched first page.
